name: Patal Bhaji
ingredients: 2 cups dried white peas (vatana), soaked overnight
instructions: 1. Pressure cook the soaked white peas and cubed potatoes with enough water, salt, and turmeric until soft.
2. Heat coconut oil in a pan and add mustard seeds; once they splutter, add curry leaves and chopped onions.
3. Sauté onions until translucent, then add the red chili powder and Malvani masala, stirring for a minute.
4. Add the cooked pea and potato mixture (with the cooking liquid) to the pan.
5. Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld, mashing a few potatoes to thicken the gravy.
6. Adjust salt, garnish with fresh coriander, and serve hot with buttered pav.
description: Patal Bhaji is a quintessential Goan vegetarian staple, deeply rooted in the local breakfast culture. Often referred to as 'Bhaji-Pav,' it is a comforting, mildly spiced, and nutritious dish found in almost every home and local canteen across the state.
